corePassives.description:
All of Tosen's attacks inflict Wound. Each stack of Wound deals damage equal to 2% of the caster's ATK every second for 10s, stacking up to 30 times. Releasing the Battlefield Skill, Flash Strike, immediately triggers all Wound stacks and clears them. 
 
 Wound is a universal character mechanic. Wound stacks from different characters can add together, but their damage is calculated separately based on each caster's ATK.
corePassives.name: Wound

corePassives.description: Tosen's Battlefield Skills reduce enemies' Thrust Resistance by 12% for 10s on hit, stacking up to 3 times.
corePassives.name: Sensory Deprivation

corePassives.description: Increases DMG from the technique Suzumushi Thrust by 100%, and from Tsuishiki - Suzumushi Thrust by 100%.
corePassives.name: Disorienting Soundwave

corePassives.description: While attacking enemies inflicted with Wound, each Wound stack increases Tosen's Crit Rate by 4%, up to a maximum increase of 24%.
corePassives.name: Bloodied Justice

skills.description: Tosen consecutively slashes the enemy in front of him with Suzumushi, striking 5 times and dealing damage equal to 490% of ATK. The 4th strike launches the non-Super Armor enemies into the air and fires 4 Benihiko Short Stings at them, inflicting 1 stack(s) of Wound on hit.
skills.name: Cry, Suzumushi

skills.description:
Tosen and his afterimage step diagonally backward, gathering enemies. They then dash at the target simultaneously and launch them into the air, dealing damage equal to 310% of ATK and inflicting 2 stack(s) of Wound. ~~Tsuishiki - Suzumushi Thrust~~ Bankai state 
 While in Bankai state, Tosen performs a follow-up attack after releasing his technique, Suzumushi Thrust, dealing damage equal to 825% of ATK and creating 4 afterimages. The afterimages then attack the enemy alongside Tosen, dealing damage equal to 355% of ATK. 
 If all techniques hit, inflicts 3 stack(s) of Wound.
skills.name: Suzumushi Thrust

skills.description:
Tosen releases Bankai, generating 9 rings from Suzumushi's tsuba to form a large realm around him and nearby enemies. The realm pulls the enemies within to the center, dealing damage equal to 2250% of ATK and inflicting 5 stack(s) of Wound. The realm lasts 10s. 
 Upon releasing, gains all Battlefield Skill Energy and refreshes the technique cooldown.
skills.name: Bankai - Suzumushi Tsuishiki - Enma Korogi

skills.description: After successfully countering an enemy, Tosen dashes behind them and slashes, dealing DMG equal to 875% of ATK and inflicting 8 stacks of Wound.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
~~While active, this Battlefield Skill grants the whole team a default 30% Thrust DMG Bonus~~ ~~Suzumushi Nishiki - Benihiko~~ Automatically triggers when a thrust teammate deals damage 
 Tosen appears on the field, performing a co-strike with the same effect as the 4th strike of his basic attack and gaining 25 Battlefield Skill Energy. This skill can only be triggered once every 3s, and while active, Tosen cannot be switched in. 
 Cannot trigger this Battlefield Skill again while at maximum Battlefield Skill Energy. ~~Flash Strike~~ Requires max Battlefield Skill Energy 
 Tosen teleports to the enemy at high speed and slashes, dealing damage equal to 240% of ATK and inflicting 2 stacks of Wound. After a brief delay, powerful Spiritual Pressure surges along his teleport path, dealing damage equal to 360% of ATK to the enemies in path and instantly triggering any Wound stacks on them. 
 If the enemies are within Tosen's Ultimate realm, triggering Wound won't clear the Wound stacks.
skills.name: Stake My Honor

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Kaname Tosen gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Flash Step
